parsed.explanation: The dominant exposure is state-tolerated targeting: a May 2026 police raid on an LGBTQ+ venue detained ~30 people without proper warrants, extorted detainees, and filed fabricated charges — state actors as perpetrators, with no hate-crime statute or anti-discrimination law offering recourse. September 2024 reporting describes intensified persecution after the disputed election, and an openly gay parliamentarian was previously declared a prisoner of conscience. No criminalization of trans expression exists, and a 2023 poll shows majority support for equal rights — but these do not offset documented police raids with no remedy. The visitor also faces no legal gender recognition pathway (irrelevant to documents but a climate signal), no facility protections, and a stalled institutional climate (supreme court suspended the anti-transphobia resolution). Worst feature: tier-2 state-tolerated targeting with thin recourse, placing this in the high-risk band.
